editorial:
Imagine living in a perfect neighborhood where every lawn is green, but your neighbor is secretly filming your every move. You will meet a housewife who looks normal on the outside, but she has a dark obsession with recording everyone around her using hidden cameras. It starts as a weird hobby, but it quickly turns into a dangerous game of control. The vibe is super tense because you feel like someone is always watching, making you question who you can actually trust in your own home.

The acting is great and really makes you feel the tension as the secrets come out. While some parts of the story move a bit slow, the payoff is totally worth it. If you love stories about secrets and spying, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you want the best picture quality, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend when you want something that keeps you guessing.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a huge crash when the housewife's secrets are finally revealed. You see that her need to record others was a way to cope with her own empty life. After the truth comes out, her relationships fall apart and she loses the control she worked so hard to keep. It wraps up by showing that spying on people never leads to happiness and only leaves you alone in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological dramas and stories about hidden secrets.
